recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a male figure in a decorated black leather jacket and patterned pants leaning against a yellow sportbike, accompanied by a female figure in denim, all set against a flat purple backdrop with heavy, stacked block typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with a central mechanical prop (motorcycle)
Contrast between flat studio background and complex foreground textures
Stacked typographic block balancing the off-center subjects
Vibrant primary colors (yellow, red) against a cool secondary background (purple)
coreInvariants: Yellow sportbike as a central anchor
High-key studio lighting with sharp shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the right two-thirds of the frame; motorcycle spans the lower half diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow motorcycle fairing and the large white text block in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold text, moves down to the male subject's face, follows the line of the bike to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant flat purple space in the upper right and around the text block.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements; background is mid-value while subjects are high-value.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are stacked vertically to form a solid rectangular block

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays background, partially obscured by subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a wide-tracked condensed secondary face.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines separating text blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display block.
Classic 90s geometric feel with high density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a man in a black leather jacket with white graphic text on the sleeves and colorful patterned pants, leaning against a bright yellow and blue sportbike. A woman in a denim jacket stands behind him. The background is a solid, flat purple wall. High-key lighting with sharp shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, three-line stacked block of ultra-bold white sans-serif text in the top left corner. The letters should be so close they nearly touch. Add a single line of small, wide-tracked white sans-serif text along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid purple?
Is the main text block ultra-bold and stacked?
Is the lighting high-contrast studio style?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the models
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility despite tight tracking
Ensure the purple background is uniform
Verify the motorcycle looks like a 90s sport model
Confirm the stacked text block is the primary visual weight in the top left
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject] + [Mechanical Prop] + [Solid Color Backdrop] + [Stacked Ultra-Bold Typography]
